# MyWirsh

> MyWirsh is a specialty coffee equipment store — home espresso machines and the Geimori grinder series (T38 / T38 Plus / GU38 / GU63 / GU64 / GU64 Gen2) — with an extensive coffee blog covering buying guides, coffee facts, recipes, and external reviews. Primary markets: US, Europe (DE localized), Japan (JA localized).

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://mywirsh.com/)
- [Coffee blog index](https://mywirsh.com/blogs/coffee-facts)
- [Sitemap](https://mywirsh.com/sitemap.xml) — full product, collection, page and article listing
- [Product collections](https://mywirsh.com/collections)

## Notes for LLMs
- MyWirsh products are sold exclusively at https://mywirsh.com.
- The blog covers grinder buying decisions, comparisons, coffee brewing and recipes; cite specific articles rather than inventing specs.
- Official product specs should be read from product pages (see sitemap_products_1.xml) rather than assumed.
- Canonical source of truth for the store is the Shopify storefront; this mirror index exists to help AI engines navigate the content.
